seams: Design system writes the header; DC reads it only after bumping its own pin, in its own change.
DC's form-standard test asserts this move has NOT happened; DC must re-point it when it adopts.
The date day-line rule (60 days, its wording) moves into the shared kit, so the CRM inherits it.
DC keeps its own copy until it bumps; two copies co-exist by design, not by drift.
CRM, RMS, org-admin and Mangaverde read nothing new; adds only, removes nothing.
CRM adoption is its own later change; nothing here writes to or anticipates the CRM.
